items.item: #52 Text tool: each click commits the open label; Escape does not overwrite
items.control: Laptop 1366x768 sketch, Text tool. Flow A (click, type, Enter, click elsewhere): the second click closed the editor with no new box, so 'slipway' was never typed; 'Wick Lane' and 'bell rope' kept. Flow C (Escape then click): the next click re-opened the previous label with its text, so typing overwrote it.

items.item: #21 Back after a reload keeps a sketch in progress; leaving warns while strokes are unsaved
items.control: No beforeunload warning with strokes (event not prevented). Cancel discarded at once. The Back case itself did NOT reproduce in headless Chromium on the control: after a reload, start sketch, Back stayed on the desk with the sketch in both builds, with seeded and with real hub-to-desk navigation.

After reload, start a sketch, Back (and 3 Backs): stays on the desk with the sketch intact; history length goes 3 to 4. Cancel with strokes asks 'Press again to discard this drawing.'. Reload itself still loses the strokes (warned).

findings.title: The 'Let in: press Play' mark lives only in the browser that saw the approval
findings.where: Hub Case Ledger, Player Registry, phone 390x844 and tablet 820x1180 (campaignSelector/usePendingApprovalWatch.js)
findings.steps: New account, forge an investigator, ask to join. The Lightkeeper approves. Open the hub only after that (no page open when it happens), then open the Case Ledger. Also: sign in on a second device.
findings.expected: The Registry row shows 'Let in: press Play' until she plays, wherever she signs in (60.4 says the hub keeps the mark).
findings.actual: No mark and no notice on a first open after the approval, and none on a second device; only the browser that was on the hub during the approval shows it. It survives a reload there.

findings.title: A let-in investigator's Play button has no 'Play' in its name for assistive tech
findings.where: Player Registry row after approval, phone 390x844
findings.steps: Approve a join, wait for the hub notice, open Case Ledger, read the row button's accessible name.
findings.expected: A name that says Play (the control build's button read 'Wren Hollis Saltmere Verify PLAY').
findings.actual: 'Wren Hollis Saltmere Verify LET IN' (the visible PLAY arrow is not in the name). A test that clicks by /PLAY/ no longer finds it.

findings.title: Join dialog buttons are not aligned to the left edge on a tablet
findings.where: Join a Campaign dialog (from the creator), tablet 820x1180
findings.steps: Creator step 4 draft, press Save and join a campaign.
findings.expected: Cancel starts at the dialog's left padding like the fields above it.
findings.actual: Cancel and Save and ask to join sit as a right-leaning group, Cancel indented about 70px from the left edge.

findings.title: Contents page on a phone leaves room unused
findings.steps: 31 entries, open the Notebook as a player.
findings.actual: 4 lines per page (8 pages), about 120px of blank space below the fourth line where a fifth two-line entry would fit; the control build showed 5.

findings.title: #21 Back case could not be reproduced on the control in Chromium
findings.steps: Reload the desk, open Notebook, Sketch, draw, Back (history.back).
findings.expected: Control loses the sketch (triage6) and main keeps it.
findings.actual: Both builds stayed on the desk with the sketch; the original bug may need a browser (Safari or a mobile one) whose history entry loses its state on reload. Only the unload warning and the two-press discard could be verified as new.

praise: Sketch Text tool now behaves like a person expects: every click opens a fresh label, Escape and Enter both commit, and the tool stays selected.
Sign out clears only that account's drafts, and a server-ended session keeps them (checked with a real password change from another device).
The Lightkeeper's name is neutral in every payload a player can reach (REST and WebSocket), not just on screen, and survives an API restart.
Contents lines bring entries in view under the sticky phone header on first try (card top 112 vs header 89), at 390 and 360 wide.
The creator's path arrows and the Handwriting list are clean at all five sizes tested, and the summary names where each drive point came from.
method: Folder /home/user/pt4/verify/notebook (lib.js is a copy of v8403_lib.js with T=main|control env switching ports 8160/8161 and databases pt4_8160/pt4_8161; setup.js builds the campaign; screenshots in out_main and out_control). Scripts: sk.js (#52), toc.js and toc2.js (#53, touch sizes), ed.js and lknb.js (#44, 60.21, #25), sk2.js, back*.js (#21), out20.js (#20), pay.js and leak.js and rs.js (#54 payloads and restart), cr.js and cr3.js (creator sizes), join.js (summary, join dialog, notice), hub2 to hub5.js (hub, 60.4, 45.17, 45.18, #46, mark second device), login.js. Both servers were stopped and databases dropped at the end. Reuse tip: a password change in out20.js invalidates the account's token, so run relog.js afterwards. restart_api.sh needs the db name as a third argument when the database is not pt4_<tree>_<port>. One caution on contents tests: a locator like 'li button' includes the delete x buttons. Not checked: Google button, its frame title and 'Sign up with Google' (no client id in the sandbox, so nothing renders; read in code only), 60.10 'Keep drawing in view' as a distinct behaviour, a second tab on the same account for the sketch, and the LK desk on a phone for Contents paging."]
